findings.4002047478: Keep the named assembly boundary. The claim that namespace-scope variables never mangle is not portable: local Clang targeting x86_64-pc-windows-msvc emits ?snd_p@@3PEAHEA without extern C and snd_p with it. These annotations are substantive for the supported MSVC ABI, not merely documentation. No BEGIN/END abstraction is necessary for two existing blocks.
findings.4002047480: Keep GPU export C linkage. MSVC ABI fixture emits ?NvOptimusEnablement@@3KA and a decorated /EXPORT directive without extern C; extern C emits the required raw NvOptimusEnablement in both symbol table and export directive. dllexport alone does not ensure the raw external name.
findings.4002047482: Retain the explicitly listed function-pointer typedef annotations as boundary documentation. Do not claim they independently enforce exported symbol names or that G3 tests type language linkage; actual definitions/imports and raw symbol checks enforce names.
findings.4002047484: Keep all five casts. q_shared.h:418 defines fallback M_PI as 3.14159265358979323846f; fovX/fovY and mingrappleangle are float. In that supported configuration the entire original argument is float. Fixture with actual header fallback emits C tan, uncast C++ tanf, cast C++ tan. The cast is redundant only on configurations whose system M_PI is double.
findings.4002047485: (int)args[2] already exists verbatim in original 8a7e8ed2 cl_cgame.c:720 and sv_game.c:976. The port adds only (char*) to the output-buffer argument under T1. No printf vararg conversion was introduced, and no new rule or format-warning suppression is appropriate. The seven recorded T21 argument casts belong to sin/cos/atan2(two arguments)/sqrt/floor/ceil.
findings.4002047487: Original 8a7e8ed2 sdl_input.c:252 already says key = (int)keysym->sym. The added outer keyNum_t cast is T3 and preserves the entire preexisting expression. Removing its inner cast would be unrelated cleanup.
findings.4002047488: Already guarded by defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(_WIN32) && (defined(__arm__) || defined(__aarch64__)); ordinary MSVC cannot see this declaration.
findings.4002047489: Retain T18 to preserve the original external-linkage contract and exact symbol gate even though current callers stay in the TU; no claim of a current behavior bug is needed.
findings.4002047491: Keep both identical empty definitions intentionally: the command definition is necessary before SDK headers reached through client.h/curl, while win_local.h preserves its own C-vtable boundary for consumers not built with those flags. Avoid saying win_local.h is fully self-contained: it requires core qboolean types first. Prior full-TU controls show dropping command definition fails lpVtbl, using =1 fails redefinition, and simply swapping includes fails qboolean/winsock ordering.
findings.4002047495: Tightening is sound only across supported configurations: do not cast arguments already double in every supported configuration. The five M_PI sites are not such cases because the engine fallback is float.
